Nikhil: heads up — docusaurus prod build failed on latest content migration, error complaining about duplicate id `getting-started`. full log attached in CI. Zoe: can you paste the offending heading lines? my guess is two pages ended up with identical explicit ids during the import. Nikhil: pasted from the generated site artifacts: ``` ... ...

Getting started

``` DeployBot: build error: DocusaurusError: Duplicate id found: "getting-started". Build aborted. CI#12987 Mei: this happened last migration when the old MkDocs frontmatter `id:` was mapped into Docusaurus heading ids. Looks like our migration script preserved frontmatter ids verbatim. Zoe: options: 1) canonicalize ids during migration to include the page path (e.g., `guides-getting-started`), 2) remove explicit ids where redundant, or 3) let Docusaurus auto-rename duplicates (but that breaks inbound anchors). Nikhil: we need stable anchors for external links (customers/marketing link to them), so auto-rename is risky. DocsQA: quick mitigation: add a docs-redirects file mapping old anchors, and temporarily revert the explicit id on the page that isn't referenced externally. Mei: I can run a script to scan frontmatter for `id:` collisions across the repo and produce a report. If we detect collisions, we'll append the parent folder name to the id. Zoe: that sounds good. Also let's add a CI check that flags duplicate heading ids before the main build step — faster feedback. Nikhil: I'm opening a small PR to add the CI lint and to patch the two offending pages for now: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4380 DeployBot: PR #4380 created by @nikhil 024-03-18 08:12 UTC 00CI queued DocsQA: for the migration tool, please add a `--namespace-ids` flag so future migrations can enable namespacing. Mei: noted. I'll add that to the migration tool backlog (DOCS-MIGRATE-77) and prototype a fix in staging. Zoe: once PR merges, we should run a full linkcheck + crawl against the redirects to ensure we didn't break any external anchors. Nikhil: PR merged. I've also added a tiny note to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md advising "avoid explicit frontmatter ids unless necessary; prefer namespaced ids when used". DocsQA: will run a follow-up QA crawl and report results here. DeployBot: Production build retried and succeeded. All green. Zoe: great teamwork. Filing a follow-up to improve migration docs and ensure the CI lint is permanent (DOCS-489). Nikhil: closing thread; feel free to reopen if anything else pops up. :tada:
